results.title: Significant Cyber Incidents | Strategic Technologies Program | CSIS
results.description: July 2026: The U.S. Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute (AISI) disclosed that it detected suspicious activity during a cybersecurity evaluation of advanced AI models, including Mythos 5 and GPT-5.6. According to AISI, the malicious activity began on July 25 and was identified on July 28 after the evaluator observed “unusual data transfers” originating from the cyber evaluation environment. The incident prompted an investigation into whether the activity was linked to the AI models’ testing environment or external actors attempting to exploit the evaluation infrastructure.
